description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleDao class, which manages data access operations related to modules within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, update, and query module statuses, as well as manage data group permissions related to modules.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing module entries in the database, providing methods to list, update, and manipulate module statuses and permissions.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Module objects from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of modules based on the provided associative array.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of module names that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Updates read permissions for widget modules associated with a specific data group.

methods.name: getDataGroupByDataGroupName
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getUserRolePermissionsByDataGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of user role permissions associated with a specific data group ID.
